description: This file implements parsing and serialization of SPDY Alternative Service header values, including handling of protocol IDs, hostnames, ports, max age, and version information, with support for QUIC version encoding.

classes.name: SpdyAltSvcWireFormat::AlternativeService
classes.description: Represents an alternative service with protocol ID, host, port, max age, and version vector.

methods.name: ParseHeaderFieldValue
methods.description: Parses a header string into a vector of alternative services.

methods.name: SerializeHeaderFieldValue
methods.description: Serializes a vector of alternative services into a header string.

methods.name: HexDecodeToUInt32
methods.description: Decodes a hex string into a uint32_t value.
